title: Make OpenClaw auth readiness converge through an eligible live fallback
summary_zh: 修復 OpenClaw readiness 在 Claude OAuth 過期時無法穩定採用健康 Codex fallback、持續 timeout 的問題；不在程式任務內變更憑證。

incident_binding.observed_failure: wait_for_openclaw_readiness timed out after 5 attempts (90s budget exhausted with CURL_REQUEST_TIMEOUT on auth_probe=true)
incident_binding.root_cause: Primary model anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 hung on expired Claude CLI OAuth session for the full 20s probe budget per attempt, preventing live OpenAI/Codex fallbacks (openai/gpt-5.6-sol, openai/gpt-5.5) from being tried within the probe budget

not_changing: credentials, tokens, secrets, or GitHub Secrets
shared model pool priority or configuration scripts
execute-plans product runtime or Lovable hosting
BFF business routes or data schemas

contracts.exact_sentinel_contract: Readiness probe strictly asserts that candidate reply equals exact PANTHEON_PROVIDER_READY sentinel (answer.strip() == PANTHEON_PROVIDER_READY). Non-matching replies (including substring prefixes/suffixes) are classified as openclaw_answer_probe_sentinel_mismatch and trigger bounded fallback or fail closed.
contracts.bounded_readiness_probe_fallback: Readiness probe partitions and reserves the bounded 20s probe budget across all configured candidates (primary and all fallbacks such as openai/gpt-5.6-sol, openai/gpt-5.5), bounding the primary candidate to <= 1.5s when fallbacks exist and fairly allocating remaining budget across fallback candidates, ensuring healthy fallback-two converges cleanly within the 20s budget if both primary and fallback-one fail/hang without incurring excessive operator login latency.
contracts.sanitized_primary_unavailable_evidence: When primary model is unavailable, readiness probe captures sanitized primary_unavailable evidence (model, status: unavailable, sanitized reason, duration_ms) without leaking secrets or tokens.
contracts.active_model_prioritization: When the readiness probe identifies a healthy fallback candidate, the provider retains the active model so that subsequent single invoke calls immediately dispatch to the verified eligible model without repeating an expired primary model call or timing out.
contracts.per_agent_routing_preservation: When invoking non-default agents (e.g. persona agents) with model=None, the provider omits the --model CLI parameter, preserving per-agent configured routing in OpenClaw without applying global primary model overrides.
contracts.side_effect_safe_invoke: Single invoke runs as a single attempt using the active probed fallback model or requested model, and never retries at invoke time on unproven auth errors, TimeoutExpired (OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT), post-execution errors, or generic invocation failures (OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_INVOCATION_FAILED) to prevent duplicate side-effecting turns.
contracts.upstream_contract_compliance: OpenResponses SSE stream strictly targets OpenClaw v2026.7.1 upstream contract (model='openclaw') and surfaces typed HTTP errors without invalid raw provider model overrides.
contracts.deterministic_fail_closed: If all candidate models fail, readiness probe deterministically fails closed with status: degraded and typed error code without retrying side-effecting invoke turns.
contracts.deployed_live_smoke_contract: scripts/openclaw-assistant-openclaw-live-smoke.sh verifies four live phases against deployed adapter: (1) provider readiness with auth_probe=true, (2) live agent turn with OPENCLAW_LIVE sentinel, (3) CLI transport assertion, (4) OpenResponses streaming.

verification.full_verification: 453 passed, 4 skipped across services/openclaw-gateway-adapter and scripts/test_openclaw_assistant_openclaw_live_smoke.py; 4/4 deployed live smoke passed without skip

deployed_live_smoke_output.phase_2_live_agent_turn: status=completed text=OPENCLAW_LIVE transport=cli active_model=openai/gpt-5.6-sol fallback_used=true duration_ms=16026

verify OpenClaw auth readiness probe returns ready within 20s when live fallback completes sentinel turn

verify single invoke runs as a single attempt using the active probed fallback model and does not retry on auth failures, generic invocation failure, TimeoutExpired, or post-execution errors
verify OpenResponses stream strictly respects upstream OpenClaw contract without invalid raw model parameters
